formula: q(alpha, k, df) such that Pr(Q > q) = alpha, k = number of groups, df = error degrees of freedom
source: Computed exactly via scipy.stats.studentized_range.ppf (same distribution underlying R's qtukey() and Tukey's HSD test); this table does not appear in any of the four source handbooks and fills a confirmed gap.
usage_note: Used for Tukey HSD after ANOVA: HSD = q(alpha, k, df_error) * sqrt(MSE / n).
